model_annotation: Figure 2 presents a horizontal bar chart illustrating the average negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant model tokens, comparing the base model (Mistral-v0.2) with its fine-tuned variants on six distinct specialty datasets. The horizontal axis categorizes the datasets as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, arranged from left to right in that order. The vertical axis represents the negative log probability, scaled linearly from 22 to 27, with tick marks appearing at regular intervals of one unit. Each bar corresponds to one specialty, colored distinctly: Cardio is dark blue, Gastro is light blue, Infect is red, Neuro is green, Obstetrics is purple, and Pediatrics is orange. The bars are all oriented horizontally and are sorted in descending order of their negative log-probability values, with the Cardio bar being the shortest (approximately 22.5) and the Pediatrics bar being the tallest (approximately 26.5). The chart visually emphasizes the performance differences between the base model and fine-tuned variants by using color-coded bars for each specialty, with the legend indicating that each color represents the model fine-tuned on that specific specialty. There is no visual emphasis such as shading, bolding, or outlining applied to any individual bar.
